author: Olive Schreiner
description: "The Story of an African Farm" by Olive Schreiner is a novel published in 1883.
longDescription: Set on a Karoo farm in 19th-century South Africa, it follows three characters—Waldo, Em, and Lyndall—from childhood into adulthood. The novel explores profound questions about faith, feminism, love, marriage, and motherhood through its semi-autobiographical protagonists.

rating.sourceTitle: The Story of an African Farm

authorInfo.bio: Olive Emilie Albertina Schreiner was a South African author, anti-war campaigner and intellectual. She is best remembered today for her novel The Story of an African Farm (1883), which has been highly acclaimed. It deals boldly with such contemporary issues as agnosticism, existential independence, individualism, the professional aspirations of women, and the elemental nature of life on the colonial frontier.
